names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Ιανουαρίου, «Άγιος Kentigern Επίσκοπος Γλασκόβης», and the page's own opening, which prints the Latin spelling with the Greek beside it in brackets; the rank words are left off.

birth.note: saint.gr's own header prints «Αγιος Kentigern Επισκοπος Γλασκοβης (527 - 612)», and its text says he fell asleep in 612 at the age of eighty-five.

death.note: saint.gr: «Θεωρείται ότι κοιμήθηκε οσίως με ειρήνη το έτος 612 μ.Χ. σε ηλικία 85 ετών» — the page marks it as what is held rather than what is certain.
